title: Oozing Australian Fennel Salad
description: A buttery, shattering fennel salad with a fermented citrus vinaigrette that melts in the mouth, perfect for a crowd-pleasing Aussie lunch.
instructions: Slice the fennel bulb into thin ribbons using a sharp knife or mandoline.
Toss the fennel ribbons with a pinch of salt and let them rest for 10 minutes to draw out bitterness.
In a small bowl, whisk together fermented soy sauce, lemon juice, olive oil, sesame seeds, dill, salt, and pepper to create the vinaigrette.
Drain the softened fennel, then sprinkle with red pepper julienned and pour the vinaigrette over the salad.
Gently toss to coat all ingredients evenly and let the salad sit for 5 minutes for flavors to meld.
Serve immediately on a chilled plate for a buttery, shattering experience.
